main_measure.name: mean unusual 5-bar move per short case, in the short direction, before costs

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day taken together

main_measure.threshold: t of the unusual move >= 2 (with supporting correlation > 0) confirms; t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: correlation of forecast and next 5-bar return on grid bars with forecast < 0

decided_by: the unusual move's t is 2 or more and the supporting correlation is above 0
reading: the profile is read from the regime column (not 'chop'), a case is the first short bet (forecast magnitude rising >= 2 from its lowest short level since the last bet) in each 5-bar grid cell of a window, the drift is the coin's mean non-overlapping 5-bar return over all its windows, the t uses day-clustered deviations, and the plan's 'fewer than 30 cases or 20 days' is applied as the minimum counts (not observable)

direction_check.why: main measure +0.01044 on the check folds against +0.02238 on every fold
